```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<p>H<sub>2</sub>O and E=mc<sup>2</sup></p>", new ConversionOptions());
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
